svg.aria-label: gridax on the GeoStack role ladder: the operators bound to a grid and a mask (differences, advection, diffusion, vorticity, the spherical forms and the diagnostic classes) as models; the advection schemes and the boundary atoms and sets as strategies; raw stencils, collocated differences, face values, limiters, C-grid terms, diagnostics, integrals, ghost-ring fillers and smooth surrogates as primitives; and the grids, masks and arrays as structures; geophysix's constants and the setup functions sit beside the ladder.
